colorException.reason: The Verified variant deliberately uses a fixed, palette-independent success green so the checkmark badge reads consistently across every theme; an adico-specific addition with no shadcn or dioxus-components equivalent.

inspirationNote: Destructive variant uses the token text-destructive-foreground where shadcn's own source hardcodes text-white -- adico is more token-compliant here, not a gap. Verified variant (emerald/white) has no shadcn or dioxus-components equivalent, already recorded in colorException. dioxus-components uses CSS modules (external style.css files), not Tailwind, so no Tailwind class-level comparison is possible there.
